title: kithd test harness: bob's assertion router uses a separate empty blob store
description: harness.rs:273: bob_assert_state receives a fresh make_blob_store() while bob's TCP listener uses bob_blob_store (line 238). The two AppState instances share the SQLite store but diverge on blobs. Any test that delivers an attachment to bob then downloads it via bob_router will silently get 404 or trigger an unexpected peer-fetch. Fix: pass Arc::clone(&bob_blob_store) to bob_assert_state.
